brief.open_with: "This is Jordan Perez, LCADC, NPI on the request. I'm calling about a 47-year-old woman in Level 2.1 IOP for severe opioid use disorder whose continued stay was denied on October 26 as 'abstinent, no longer meets medical necessity'."

criteria.title: D5 · Relapse, continued use or continued problem potential.
criteria.text: Abstinent since Sep 14 — six weeks, all inside the Level 2.1 structure (UDS negative Sep 21, 28, Oct 5, 12, 19). Before admission: 3 relapses in 12 months, each within 2 weeks of leaving structured treatment, and an ED visit for overdose on Aug 30. Abstinence achieved with the structure is the reason to continue it, not to remove it.

criteria.title: D4 and D6 · Readiness and recovery environment.
criteria.text: D4: engaged, attends 3 of 3 days, but still ambivalent about MAT (started naltrexone Oct 15). D6: lives with a partner who uses; sober-housing placement not available until Nov 20.

criteria.title: Step-down criteria not yet met.
criteria.text: She has not yet shown she can keep abstinence with less structure (no trial of reduced days), her housing is unchanged, and naltrexone has been in place 2 weeks. Plan: step down to Level 1 once housing is secured, about Nov 20.

brief.level_of_care: Without Level 2.1 she returns to a home where her partner uses, with no structured days. Her last three relapses each came within two weeks of leaving structured care; the next step for her history is the ED, not Level 1.
questions: "She's abstinent. Why does she still need IOP?"
Abstinent inside the structure. ASAM continued-service criteria look at D5 risk without the structure: three relapses within two weeks of discharge in the last year, and an overdose Aug 30.
"Why not step her down to Level 1 now?"
Step-down criteria aren't met: no sober housing until Nov 20 (D6), naltrexone two weeks in, no trial of fewer days. We are asking for 4 more weeks, to Nov 20, then Level 1.
Naltrexone started Oct 15, sober housing booked, and a relapse plan written with her in group. Those need the four weeks to hold.
18 of 18 IOP days since Sep 14, every UDS negative. Group notes and UDS results attached.
